name: Arc Blade Trainer
material: low-heat ceramic core, rubberised nerf-leather grip
description: The practice blade every initiate buys first and every parent regrets second. Low-heat emitter, high-drama hum.

name: Emitter Hilt
material: machined duralloy shell, knurled brass grip rings
description: A bare hilt for people who say they will build their own blade. Ships without a blade. We said bare.

name: Sovereign Arc Duellist
material: tempered duralloy twin-core, hand-wrapped nerf-leather grip
description: Collector tier. Hand-balanced, twin-emitter, above the refund limit and above most ceilings.

name: Core Crystal Case
description: Padded case for one core crystal. Protects against drops, dust and the urge to hold it up to the light at dinner.

name: Drift Vault Case
description: Twelve-slot vault for a serious collection. The lock is real. The collection is your problem.

name: Orbit Stand
material: powder-coated steel arm, magnetic ceramic cradle
description: Magnetic wall stand that floats one blade at a slight angle. The angle is 7 degrees. We tested 6 and 8. Trust us.

name: Wayfarer Cloak
description: Hooded travel cloak in desert sand. Hides the face, the mood and most of a week's laundry.

name: Initiate Robe
description: Beginner's robe in undyed cotton. Looks humble, feels humble, is machine washable, which is the real virtue.

name: Drift Boots
material: soft felt-lined suede, silent rubber sole
description: Soft-sole boots for quiet entrances. Not approved for quiet exits from arguments.

name: Quartermaster Belt
description: Nine pouches, one blade clip, zero explanations needed at the door. Leather, brass, pride.

name: Sidearm Holster
description: Drop-leg holster for a sidearm you are not allowed to carry here. Fits a torch nicely.

name: Pilgrim Pack
description: Canvas daypack for long walks to remote temples. Currently out of stock, like most remote temples.

name: Dual-Phase Practice Pole
material: tempered duralloy shaft, twin ceramic cores
description: A two-ended trainer for people who find one end insufficient. Twice the blade, twice the apologies to the lampshade.

name: Pocket Emitter Keyring
description: A thumb-sized hilt that lights a 4 cm blade. Finds keys, impresses nobody over nine, sells out every winter.

name: Hilt Grip Tape Roll
description: Five metres of textured grip tape. For hilts, racquets and the one drawer handle that keeps coming off.

name: Crimson Cadet Trainer
material: low-heat ceramic core, crimson-lacquered nerf-leather grip
description: The trainer in a red finish for customers going through something. Same safety rating, more eyeliner.

name: Blade Hum Tuning Kit
material: three tuned brass resonators, steel micro-wrench
description: Three resonators and a tiny wrench so your blade hums in the key you deserve. Neighbours not included.

name: Ceremonial Display Blade
material: polished duralloy blade, walnut wall mount
description: Does not ignite. Does not need to. Sits on a wall and makes guests lower their voices.

name: Core Crystal Polishing Cloth
description: Lint-free cloth for crystals, lenses and the screen you keep touching. Three in a pack because you will lose two.

name: Cracked Core Recycling Pouch
description: Send a cracked core back in this padded pouch and get store credit. Honest about failure, which is rare in cores.

name: Twin Core Travel Tin
description: A pocket tin for two cores. Rattles pleasantly. Confuses airport scanners in a way that is legal but memorable.

name: Humidity-Controlled Core Cabinet
description: Forty slots, a hygrometer and a lock. For collectors who have stopped pretending it is a phase.

name: Carbonite-Style Ice Tray
description: Freezes six ice blocks in the shape of a very surprised man. He is fine. He is ice.

name: Core Crystal Cleaning Solution
material: alcohol-free ozone-scented solution in a glass bottle
description: Alcohol-free cleaner in a 100 ml bottle. Smells faintly of ozone and regret. Do not drink, even on a dare.

name: Quartermaster's Apron
description: Waxed canvas apron with a blade loop and a pocket for the receipt you will need when you cut the apron.

name: Temple Slippers
material: pressed wool felt, grippy rubber sole
description: Felt slippers for cold stone floors and long meditations about whether you locked the speeder.

name: Outer Rim Scarf
description: Loose-weave scarf in two sand tones. Covers the face from dust storms and from acquaintances.

name: Hooded Training Tunic
description: Sweat-wicking tunic with a hood that stays up when you turn your head dramatically. We tested the head turn.

name: Scoundrel's Vest
material: fitted charcoal wool blend, silk lining
description: Fitted vest with four hidden pockets. Nothing in them is our business. Dry clean only, you absolute rogue.

name: Bad Feeling About This Tee
description: Organic cotton tee that says what everyone in the meeting is thinking. Runs slightly small, like your patience.

name: Emitter-Print Socks
description: Two pairs of socks printed with tiny hilts. The gift for the person who has every other item on this list.

name: Not-a-Moon Desk Globe
material: grey resin sphere, brushed steel base
description: A grey desk globe with a suspicious dish on one side. It is a paperweight. It is definitely a paperweight.

name: Do or Do Not Planner
description: Undated weekly planner with no column for 'try'. Four hundred pages of accountability in recycled paper.

name: Protocol Etiquette Flashcards
description: Two hundred cards on greetings, titles and when to stop talking. The last card is blank. That is the lesson.

name: Rolling Companion Cooler
description: A domed cooler on three wheels that follows you if you pull the handle. Beeps when opened. Beeps when closed. Beeps.

name: Hangar Floor Mat
description: Ribbed rubber mat printed with landing markings. Puts the garage in a mood. Also catches oil.

name: Smuggler's Compartment Lunchbox
description: Steel lunchbox with a false bottom for a second sandwich. The compartment is for sandwiches. Officially.

name: Nav Chart Wall Poster
description: A1 star-lane chart of a galaxy that does not exist, drawn with the confidence of one that does. Frame not included.

name: Cantina Band Playlist Speaker
description: Portable speaker preloaded with one song. You know the song. It is the only song. Battery lasts nine hours of it.

name: Herd Animal Grooming Brush
material: beechwood body, stiff boar-free nylon bristles
description: Stiff-bristle brush for large, woolly, opinionated livestock. Also works on carpets and certain uncles.

name: Cerulean Milk Powder
material: vanilla milk powder in a resealable foil pouch
description: Sweet vanilla milk powder that mixes an alarming shade of blue. Vegan. Served warm at every farm we know of.

name: Desert Moisture Collector Kit
description: A garden-scale condenser that pulls a litre of water from dry air per day. Farm chores, now a lifestyle.

name: Speeder Parking Sign
description: Enamel sign: RESERVED FOR SPEEDERS, ALL OTHERS WILL BE TOWED TO A DISTANT SYSTEM. Rust-proof, argument-proof.

name: Pilot's Headset Stand
description: Walnut stand shaped like a helmet silhouette. Holds a headset, a cap or the hat you bought at the cantina.

name: Emergency Escape Pod Blanket
material: metallised polyester film in a steel tin
description: Reflective thermal blanket in a tin marked ESCAPE POD. Camping, car boot, or a dramatic exit from a cold sofa.

name: Holo-Chess Travel Set
description: Magnetic travel board with eight monster pieces. No holograms, no screaming, let the big one win anyway.

name: Asteroid Field Stress Balls
description: Three grey foam rocks for your desk. Squeeze during meetings. Odds of relief: never tell us the odds.

name: Bounty Board Cork Board
description: Framed cork board with a WANTED header. For chores, invoices and the person who keeps eating your lunch.

name: Hyperlane Route Coffee Mug
description: Ceramic mug with the fastest route from bed to kitchen in under twelve parsecs. Dishwasher safe. Physics optional.

name: Mechanic's Knee Pads
description: Gel knee pads for the hours spent under a ship that will never fly. Sold as a pair. Sold often.
